proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C hA hC h
  have e := EuclideanGeometry.law_cos A B C
  have hc : Real.cos (EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C) ≤ 0 :=
    Real.cos_nonpos_of_pi_div_two_le_of_le h (by linarith [EuclideanGeometry.angle_le_pi A B C, Real.pi_pos])
  have p1 : 0 < dist A B := dist_pos.mpr hA
  have p2 : 0 < dist C B := dist_pos.mpr hC
  have hge : dist A B * dist A B + dist C B * dist C B ≤ dist A C * dist A C := by
    rw [e]; nlinarith [mul_pos p1 p2]
  have p3 : 0 ≤ dist A C := dist_nonneg
  constructor <;> nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), A ≠ B → C ≠ B → Real.pi / 2 ≤ EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C → dist A B < dist A C ∧ dist C B < dist A C
